{{- /* The page body as standalone Markdown, for the per-page index.md (_default/single.markdown.md, _default/list.markdown.md, reference/*.markdown.md). It is what the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) calls LLM-friendly content: the same Markdown the author wrote, with everything Hugo-specific resolved. - Shortcodes are rendered (.RenderShortcodes) with their `markdown` templates (shortcodes/.markdown.md). A shortcode without one falls back to its .html template. - Generator comments ("Do not edit this file" on API reference pages) are dropped, CRLF line ends become LF and runs of blank lines collapse to one. - api-documenter's HTML tables (symbol lists, properties, parameters) become Markdown tables (md/tables.html). Hand-written HTML in guides is left as written. - In a guide, a code span naming an API symbol (`IMeasure`) links to its reference page, as on the HTML page (md/code-links.html). Generated reference pages carry their own links. - Every page-relative (`../quickstart/`) and root-relative (`/latest/api-reference/...`, which is also what relref returns) link or image becomes an absolute URL, because the file is read outside the site or pasted into a prompt, where a relative path has no base. A link to a page that has a Markdown version points to that version (md/links.html). Links with a scheme (https:, mailto:) and in-page anchors are kept. Expects: the page. Returns the Markdown string (never prints: this is an .html template, and printing from it would HTML-escape the text). */ -}} {{- $u := urls.Parse .Permalink -}} {{- $base := printf "%s/" (strings.TrimSuffix "/" (urls.Parse site.BaseURL).Path) -}} {{- $links := partialCached "md/links.html" site -}} {{- /* A build without baseURL (a laptop `hugo` run) has no host; the links stay root-relative then. `hugo server` has a host but no scheme (//localhost:1313/): the links are protocol-relative. */ -}} {{- $origin := "" -}} {{- with $u.Host }}{{ $origin = printf "%s//%s" (cond (ne $u.Scheme "") (printf "%s:" $u.Scheme) "") . }}{{ end -}} {{- /* api-documenter writes CRLF line ends; everything below splits on "\n". */ -}} {{- $out := replace (.RenderShortcodes | string) "\r\n" "\n" -}} {{- $out = replaceRE `(?s)` "" $out -}} {{- $out = partial "md/tables.html" $out -}} {{- if ne .Params.source "api-documenter" }}{{ $out = partial "md/code-links.html" (dict "page" . "text" $out) }}{{ end -}} {{- /* `](target)` and `](target "title")`; the title, if any, is kept as written. */ -}} {{- range findRESubmatch `\]\(([^)\s]+)((?:\s+"[^"]*")?)\)` $out -}} {{- $href := index . 1 -}} {{- $title := index . 2 -}} {{- $keep := or (findRE `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:` $href) (hasPrefix $href "#") -}} {{- if not $keep -}} {{- $path := $href -}} {{- $fragment := "" -}} {{- with findRESubmatch `^([^#]*)(#.*)$` $href -}} {{- $path = index (index . 0) 1 -}} {{- $fragment = index (index . 0) 2 -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Root-relative: under the site's base path. relref includes that path already when the site does not canonify URLs (/docs/latest/...), and leaves it out when it does (/latest/...). */ -}} {{- $dir := $u.Path -}} {{- if hasPrefix $path "/" -}} {{- $dir = cond (and (ne $base "/") (hasPrefix $path $base)) "/" $base -}} {{- end -}} {{- $joined := path.Clean (path.Join $dir $path) -}} {{- if and (hasSuffix $path "/") (ne $joined "/") -}}{{- $joined = printf "%s/" $joined -}}{{- end -}} {{- $target := printf "%s%s" $joined $fragment -}} {{- /* A link written without the trailing slash (`/latest/visualisations/pie-chart`) is the same page. A member's section already carries its fragment; any other fragment is kept. */ -}} {{- with or (index $links $joined) (index $links (printf "%s/" $joined)) -}} {{- $target = cond (strings.Contains . "#") . (printf "%s%s" . $fragment) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $out = replace $out (printf "](%s%s)" $href $title) (printf "](%s%s%s)" $origin $target $title) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Removed comments and shortcodes leave runs of blank lines; one is enough. */ -}} {{- return trim (replaceRE `\n[ \t]*(\n[ \t]*)+\n` "\n\n" $out) " \n" -}}
